title: ASPARAGUS IN THE OVEN
instructions: Take four bundles of asparagus. Boil them. Cut off the soft tips about an inch long. Add to them a pint of sweet milk. Mix two or three eggs, a teaspoonful of flour (into which a teaspoonful of butter is mixed), salt,  pepper,  butter,  onion juice,  parsley. Add all together with a soup&#231;on of grated cheese on top, and put in the oven to bake for fifteen minutes.
